promptTemplates.terrain-material: Generate one original, evenly lit, top-down pixel-art {{material}} material master matching the AISLAND golden beach palette. Uniform surface only, restrained microtexture, no objects, no shoreline, no border, no grid, no text, no perspective, no cast shadow. It will be periodicized and compiled into 32 px Mixed Wang tiles; do not attempt to draw final edge or corner tiles.
promptTemplates.identity-master: Create a 1x3 identity sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta. Three ordinary civilian island survivors, full body, top-down three-quarter pixel art, same camera, scale, foot line and upper-left lighting as the AISLAND golden beach. Columns: lean navy-jacketed Lin Che with black hair and small pack; broad olive-shirted Shi Lei with cropped hair; slim mustard-jacketed Su He with tied dark hair. No weapons, armor, fantasy clothing, text, grid lines, shadow outside each cell or overlapping cells.
promptTemplates.locomotion: Create a strict 4x4 sprite sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta for {{character}}, preserving the accepted identity. Rows are down, left, right and up; each row is a coherent four-frame idle/walk cycle. Fixed body scale, foot line, camera and upper-left lighting; centered one figure per cell; no detached effects, text, grid lines or overlap.
promptTemplates.actions: Create a strict 4x4 action sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta for {{character}}, preserving the accepted identity, scale, foot line, camera and lighting. Row-major actions: observe, low reach, consume, offer, receive, refuse, talk, shout, build fire, add fuel, search, rest, sleep, wake, exhausted, death. One grounded pose per cell, no detached effects, text, grid lines or overlap.
promptTemplates.vegetation: Create a strict 2x3 prop sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta: six distinct tropical island trees matching the AISLAND golden beach, with readable trunks, separable canopies, consistent top-down three-quarter camera and upper-left light. One centered tree per cell, clean silhouette, no overlap, text or grid lines.
promptTemplates.structural: Create a strict 3x4 prop/state sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta. promptTemplates.resources: Create a strict 4x4 resource state sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta. promptTemplates.items: Create a strict 2x4 ground-item sheet on exact #FF00FF magenta: water bottle, food ration, lighter, tinder, wood log, backpack, empty water bottle, first-aid kit.
